작품을 전시하고 수업을 진행한 현장을 사진과 글로 남깁니다. 펀딩과 수상: Notes and photos from our exhibitions and classes, alongside crowdfunding and award news.
9월 12일, 성남동 젊음의거리에서 열린 2026 울산 중구 청년예술제에: On September 12, we took part in the 2026 Ulsan Jung-gu Youth Arts Festival on Youth Street in Seongnam-dong. We exhibited our murder mystery games at the Youth Didimter booth.

부스에는 뱀이 죽은 축제, 레드가 죽은 연구소, 미식의 대가, 의사가 너: We brought The Festival Where the Snake Died, The Lab Where Red Died, The Gourmet Master, and Too Many Doctors! We stood the boxes upright to show their covers and laid out character materials at the front of the table.

9월 5일 울릉고등학교에서 학생들과 게임을 체험하고, AI로 지역 콘텐츠: On September 5, we held a workshop at Ulleung High School with game activities and AI-assisted local content planning. The class focused on turning things students wanted to try on Ulleungdo into content ideas.
수업에서는 울릉도에서 좋아하는 것과 바꾸고 싶은 것, 해보고 싶은 일을: We discussed what students liked about Ulleungdo, what they wanted to change, and what they wanted to try. The presentation includes an activity for organizing local ideas by place, people, situations, and rules.
9월 5일 울릉고등학교의 AI 활용 지역 콘텐츠 제작 수업: The September 5 AI-assisted local content workshop at Ulleung High School.
게임 체험에서 한 줄 기획안으로: From playing a game to a one-line concept
학생들은 모둠별로 머더미스터리 게임을 체험했습니다. 역할을 맡고 단서를: Students tried a murder mystery game in groups, taking roles, reading clues, and explaining what they learned to one another.
이어지는 AI 실습은 자신의 아이디어를 먼저 적고 질문을 덧붙이는 순서로: The AI exercise started with students writing their own ideas before adding questions. The final task was to summarize a title, setting, roles, mission, and clues in a one-line concept.
모둠별로 역할과 단서를 확인하며 게임을 체험하는 학생들: Students checking their roles and clues during the group game activity.
7월 4일 울릉고등학교 전산실에서 울릉군 글로벌 생태관광 전문인재 양성: On July 4, we taught a session for Ulleung County's Global Ecotourism Professional Training Program in the computer lab at Ulleung High School. The one-day course covered using AI to create tourism copy and web pages.
관광 소재를 소개 문구로 정리하기: Turning tourism topics into descriptive copy
실습은 소개할 관광 소재를 고르는 것부터 시작했습니다. AI로 홍보 문구: The exercise began with choosing a tourism topic. Participants then used AI to refine copy and images before putting them into a web page.
관광 홍보 문구와 웹페이지를 만드는 전산실 실습: Working on tourism copy and web pages in the computer lab.
웹페이지 제작까지 실습한 하루: A day of practice, through to building a web page
교육에서는 문구 작성에 그치지 않고, 관광 정보를 웹페이지로 만드는 과정: The course covered both writing copy and building a web page for tourism information. The lesson and practice materials are collected in the resource library.
